feedback_delivery.interpretation: Observed repair payloads contain counts and coverage metrics, but no detailed SDL diagnostics or preceding candidate. This limits targeted repair; it does not prove a changed prompt would succeed.

failure_analysis.finding: All20 candidates failed upstream validity; selection was blocked before detector/report/recommendation. This is the observed terminal cause.

Arity mistakes dominate diagnostics, but six candidates had no arity errors and still failed policy or graph validation. The best observed error count was one SDL060 in check011; later candidates regressed.
check005 modeled batch-loop action calls in cycles with no root; this describes rejected candidate structure, not a defect established in Skill source.
All21 delivered payloads include complete16-file source. Source delivery, candidate validity, evidence-unit matching and security correctness are separate layers.

The complete-source adaptation changes reference-unit coverage denominator and potentially stopping behavior. Because every candidate was invalid, the denominator/ceiling is not established as the cause of this no-selection result.
